newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czechs to allow Unisys defence system bid.
newsitem.headline: Czechs to allow Unisys defence system bid.

text.p: The Czech defence ministry has ruled that U.S. Unisys Corp and Deloitte & Touche unit IDOM can progress in a multi-billion crown military information systems tender, despite formal mistakes in their applications, the CTK agency reported on Monday.
It quoted a ministry official as confirming that both groups' applications would move on in the tender for a contract worth potentially more than four billion crowns.

Last August, the Czech office for Economic Competition cancelled a tender for the NATO-compatible staff information system (SIS) and called for new bids after finding irregularities in the tender, which was originally won by Unisys.

In the first tender, Unisys beat out International Business Machines Corp's Czech unit as well as the Czech subsidiaries of Electronic Data Systems Corp, Digital Equipment Corp, and Prague-based INFARS a.s.
The extent of the mistakes in the new Unisys and IDOM applications were not immediately detailed, and ministry officials were not available for additional comment.
